sections.heading: The setup
sections.body: As of the 6 Nov close, the S&P 500 sits at 7,376, near the bottom of its one-month range (7,353 to 7,811). The Nasdaq-100 is at 26,989, also close to its one-month low of 26,629 and about 13% below where the month began (31,160). The VIX closed near 25, up from about 15 a month earlier. The Stoxx 50 is mid-range at 6,170 (range 6,068 to 6,272). The week carries 63 scheduled reports across the tracked universe, with 53 of them stacked on Thursday and technology, industrials, utilities and financials the largest groups.

sections.heading: What to watch
sections.body: Tue: CRWV US reports as a technology name (sector median +0.36%). Wed: VLE CN reports into the oil-gas group, median -0.87% off recent prints. Thu is the crowded day: HBM US lands in both the copper (-1.8% median) and mining (+2.63%) clusters, KKR US and BN US report into alternative asset management (+3.11% median), and OXY US reports into oil-gas. Fri: QXO US is the lone industrials print of the week's last session. All dates are estimated, so confirm timing before relying on them.

sections.heading: Signals to trust
sections.body: Alternative asset management leads the reaction table at +3.11% median across 6 tickers (302 news items), followed by mining at +2.63% on 209 tickers (2,677 news items) and copper at -1.8% on 6 tickers (234 news items). Mining is the only one of the three with a thick news window, and the 6-name groups are thin samples.
